name: Burning Liquid Fuel
description: A Blaze Burner normally eats solid fuel.

pages.title: Burning Liquid Fuel
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A plain **Blaze Burner** burns piped fuels such as lava, Seed Oil and TFMG's diesel
- Crude oil and creosote need the **Straw** burner
- **Bioethanol**, **Peanut Oil** and **napalm** superheat a plain burner
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Burning fuel makes smog

A Blaze Burner normally eats solid fuel. Two mods let it burn fluids from pipes instead, which is how oil products and biofuels reach Create's heat. See [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().

pages.title: Create: Liquid Fuel
pages.text: A plain Blaze Burner takes piped fluid: lava, Seed Oil, Bioethanol, Peanut Oil, and TFMG's diesel, gasoline, kerosene, naphtha, heavy oil and napalm.

Bioethanol, Peanut Oil and TFMG's napalm superheat the burner (the blue flame). The others only heat it. Seed Oil and Bioethanol come from Crafts & Additions; Peanut Oil from [#](2E5AAC)[Garnished](entry://food/garnished)[#](). Peanut Oil burns 5,000 [#](7A3C9A)[ticks](entry://glossary/tick)[#]() a bucket in either burner.

pages.title: Blaze Burner with Straw
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' version. Add a Straw to a Blaze Burner and it takes fuel from buckets or pipes.

TFMG's diesel, gasoline, crude oil and creosote all burn in the Straw burner, through [#](7A3C9A)[shared fluid tags](entry://glossary/tags)[#](). Crude oil and creosote need the Straw burner; TFMG's other fuels work in a plain Blaze Burner too.

pages.title: Straw
pages.text: Craft this to convert a Blaze Burner. Biofuel chain: crops to Biomass, seeds to Seed Oil, then Bioethanol. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** a Blaze Burner, with or without Straw, makes smog while it burns fuel. See [#](2E5AAC)[Pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#]().\
\
Solid-fuel option: [Biomass Pellets](item://createaddition:biomass_pellet).

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Straw burner fuels, burn time per 1000 [#](7A3C9A)[mB](entry://glossary/mb)[#]():
- diesel, gasoline and biodiesel: 24000 ticks
- lava: 20000
- crude oil: 9600
- ethanol: 8000
- creosote and plant oil: 4800

Bioethanol (biofuel tag) is superheated.
